_why: Opt-in typecheck for scripts/, which the root tsconfig excludes. Run `pnpm typecheck:scripts`. NOT a CI gate yet: 29 legacy scripts carry 70 pre-existing errors, so gating on it would be red on arrival. It exists because the root tsc silently passed a script that called an undefined function (refresh-paid-endpoints, 2026-08-23) — nothing else would have caught it.
